capturePage.title: Capture
capturePage.description: Do a real task while Socrates watches your screen. It asks why at natural pauses, closes the gaps in a short debrief, and turns it into a workflow.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1: 1. Open the mock ERP in another tab, start a session and share that tab. Tell Socrates what you're about to do.
howItWorks.step2: 2. Work as usual and think out loud. Socrates asks 3–5 questions at natural pauses.
howItWorks.step3: 3. Say you're done: a short spoken debrief, then Socrates explains it back.
howItWorks.offTheRecord: Say "off the record" or flip the switch any time. Nothing is captured until you're back on the record.

newSession.title: New session
newSession.description: Who's showing what? You can refine the task by voice.
newSession.task: What are you about to do?
newSession.defaultTask: Process this week's supplier invoices in the ERP before the month-end close.

recording.shareTitle: Share your screen to start recording
recording.shareHint: Pick the window you'll work in (e.g. the mock ERP). Socrates watches, groups what you do into steps and draws the workflow here.
